programme.title: Salvación en Señales y Símbolos
programme.desc: El programa “Salvación en Señales y Símbolos” tiene como propósito educar al interesado en entender el Apocalipsis. Romper cualquier duda o barreras que mantenga a lector alejado, intimidado, o tenga cualquier predisposición en contra de las enseñanzas en el Apocalipsis. La visión de las 7 Trompetas han tenido variadas interpretaciones pero este estudio cuidadoso nos lleva a la realidad considerando la interpretación más razonable de las representaciones de esta escena de juicios de parte de Dios. Vemos que nos lleva al Santuario por los muebles allí mencionados para poder entender. Las trompetas suenan por la razón de que en capítulos anteriores los santos clamaban por justicia por lo tanto son la contestación de Dios interviniendo. Tenga su Biblia en mano y estudiemos juntos el libro misterioso y descubramos su importancia.

programme.title: 3ABN Hoy En Vivo
programme.sub-title: El sábado como un don amoroso de Dios
programme.desc: En esta transmisión especial de dos horas, el pastor John Dinzey, gerente general de 3ABN, y el pastor Eduardo Mack profundizan en el estudio bíblico del sábado, destacándolo no solo como un día de reposo, sino como un regalo divino destinado a restaurar la vida espiritual, emocional y relacional del creyente. A lo largo del programa, ambos pastores presentan el fundamento bí blico del sábado desde la creación hasta el ministerio de Jesús, subrayando su carácter santificado por Dios y su propósito como un espacio sagrado para reconectar con Él. También exploran su relevancia para la vida actual, mostrando cómo la observancia del sá bado fortalece la fe, la identidad espiritual y la relación con el Creador. El objetivo central del programa es invitar al espectador a comprender el sábado como un don amoroso de Dios, diseñado para renovar el corazón y enriquecer la experiencia cristiana hoy. Para una variedad de programas de estudios bíblicos, baje la aplicación 3ABN+ y suscríbase al canal 3ABN Latino YouTube. Envie sus preguntas a Latino@3abn.tv Programa EVH250007.

programme.title: El panel de Escuela Sabática de 3ABN
programme.sub-title: Poniendo a prueba a los profetas
programme.desc: ¿Cómo podemos saber si alguien que afirma tener el don de profecía realmente está hablando en nombre de Dios? Esta lección explora las pruebas bíblicas de un verdadero profeta, comenzando con el consejo de 1 Juan 4:1 de “probar los espíritus”. Así como un diamante es examinado para comprobar su autenticidad, las afirmaciones proféticas deben ser cuidadosamente probadas por medio de las Escrituras. Descubre los principios bíblicos que revelan si el mensaje, el carácter, las predicciones y la influencia de un profeta están de acuerdo con la Palabra de Dios. Aprende por qué el discernimiento es esencial y cómo los creyentes pueden reconocer el verdadero ministerio profético y evitar el engaño con mayor confianza.\.

programme.sub-title: Tras las escenas: Proyecto Obreros Bíblicos en Cuba
programme.desc: John e Idalia Dinzey animan a nuestro público a orar y, quienes puedan, a contribuir con apoyo financiero para el esfuerzo de reclutar 40 obreros bíblicos por nueve meses. Disfrutemos de un resumen de lo que Dios nos permitió alcanzar durante el 2025, incluyendo nuevos proyectos de producción y visitas a otros países. Invitamos al público especialmente a considerar ser parte del esfuerzo evangelístico en La Habana, Cuba, del 4 al 11 de abril de 2025. Su participación puede marcar una diferencia eterna. Gracias por unirse en el apoyo a la predicación del Evangelio. This spells trouble for his past-life best friend, Philip Train (Ryan O'Neal), who is now pursuing Corinne.

programme.title: Against All Odds
programme.desc: A Los Angeles bookie (James Woods) hires an ex-football star (Jeff Bridges) to find his runaway mistress (Rachel Ward) in Mexico.","large":"Having been cut from his professional football team, down-and-out athlete Terry Brogan (Jeff Bridges) is in desperate need of money. Crooked nightclub owner and bookie Jake Wise (James Woods) offers Terry a hefty sum to go to Mexico and find his girlfriend, Jessie Wyler (Rachel Ward). Terry cannot turn the offer down. When Terry locates Jessie, the two fall in love. Terry reports that he failed to find her; but Jake sends someone else. Terry and Jessie's love must endure unexpected twists.

programme.title: No Mercy
programme.desc: A Chicago detective (Richard Gere) flees through a bayou, handcuffed to the Cajun mistress (Kim Basinger) of a ponytailed crime lord (Jeroen Krabbé).","large":"After his partner is killed by the merciless crime boss Losado, Chicago cop Eddie Jillette takes to New Orleans to settle the score. When he finds Losado's mistress, Michel, Eddie handcuffs himself to the girl and heads for the bayou in an effort to draw out his rival. And though squatting in a swamp handcuffed to another person is no recipe for romance, Eddie and Michel soon find themselves falling in love even as Losado is closing in.

programme.title: Gloria
programme.desc: A street-toughened woman (Sharon Stone) goes on the run with a 7-year-old boy (Jean-Luke Figueroa) whose parents were killed by mobsters.","large":"After serving three years in prison covering for her gangster boyfriend, Kevin (Jeremy Northam), Gloria (Sharon Stone) returns to New York City for the money she was promised. Inside Kevin's base of operations, she finds 7-year-old Nicky (Jean-Luke Figueroa), whose family has been killed. Nicky is hanging onto a computer disk that incriminates the gang. Kevin refuses to pay Gloria, so she steals Nicky and the evidence. On the run in the city, the cynical ex-convict and the young boy grow close.

programme.title: Home Invasion
programme.desc: A mother (Veronica Hamel) and daughter (Bonnie Root) try to outwit robbers holding them and three friends captive.

programme.title: Blue-Eyed Butcher
programme.desc: Susan Wright (Sara Paxton) stands trial for the murder of her husband (Justin Bruening) in their Texas home.

programme.title: The River Murders
programme.desc: A homicide detective investigating a series of murders becomes the prime suspect when the FBI uncovers his close ties to all the victims.

programme.title: Maximum Risk
programme.desc: Federal agents and the Russian Mafia chase a French policeman (Jean-Claude Van Damme) on a mission in New York City.","large":"French police officer Alain Moreau makes an astonishing discovery: Mikhail, a man who died recently in a breakneck car chase, is the twin brother he never knew. Alain then uncovers a web of family secrets that lead him to New York City, where his brother was involved with the Russian Mafia. Teaming up with Mikhail's lover, Alex Minetti, Alain must now assume his twin's identity and go undercover to avenge Mikhail's death.

programme.title: Desperate Measures
programme.desc: To save his terminally ill son, a San Francisco policeman (Andy Garcia) arranges for a sociopathic killer (Michael Keaton) to donate bone marrow.","large":"Widowed cop Frank Conner (Andy Garcia) is determined to secure a bone marrow transplant for his son, Matt (Joseph Cross), who will die of leukemia if a suitable donor isn't found. Conner discovers that incarcerated serial murderer Peter McCabe (Michael Keaton) is a match for Matt, and the psychopath eventually agrees to donate marrow, but he escapes from the operating room just before the procedure. Conner quickly follows, but the scheming McCabe won't be easily apprehended.

programme.title: Mortal Thoughts
programme.desc: Best friends (Demi Moore, Glenne Headly) in New Jersey get in trouble after one's rotten husband (Bruce Willis) goes too far.","large":"A loathsome man ends up dead, but it's not clear who's to blame. If ever a person got what he deserved, it's James Urbanski (Bruce Willis), an abusive drunk who steals from his wife, Joyce (Glenne Headly), and promises her close friend Cynthia Kellogg (Demi Moore) that she'll be the next target of his rage. At a group outing, James bleeds to death after someone cuts his throat. But because he's such a terrible human being, police aren't sure which of his acquaintances decided to kill him.

programme.title: Obsessed
programme.desc: A successful, happily married executive (Idris Elba) becomes the object of unwanted affection from a temp worker (Ali Larter) at his company.","large":"Things couldn't be better for Derek Charles (Idris Elba). He's just received a big promotion at work, and has a wonderful marriage with his beautiful wife, Sharon (Beyoncé Knowles). However, into this idyllic world steps Lisa (Ali Larter), a temporary worker at Derek's office. Lisa begins to stalk Derek, jeopardizing all he holds dear.

programme.title: It Could Happen to You
programme.desc: A New York policeman (Nicolas Cage) keeps his promise to split a $4 million lottery prize with a waitress (Bridget Fonda), but his wife objects.","large":"Charlie Lang (Nicolas Cage) is a simple, kindhearted New York City cop. When he realizes he has no money to tip waitress Yvonne Biasi (Bridget Fonda), Lang offers her half the winnings of his lottery ticket. Amazingly, the ticket happens to be a winner, in the sum of $4 million. True to his word, Lang proceeds to share the prize money with Biasi, which infuriates his greedy wife, Muriel (Rosie Perez). Not content with the arrangement, Muriel begins scheming to take all the money.

programme.title: Crazy in Alabama
programme.desc: An eccentric (Melanie Griffith) kills her abusive husband and heads to Hollywood to pursue her dreams.","large":"In 1965, eccentric Lucille Vinson murders her abusive husband, chops off his head and flees to Hollywood to pursue television fame. Back in her Alabama hometown, nephew Peejoe Bullis witnesses the killing of a young black man by racist sheriff John Doggett and is unsure whether he should testify against him. When the law catches up with Lucille, she returns home, where Peejoe is becoming increasingly involved with the civil rights movement.

programme.title: Stealing Harvard
programme.desc: A nitwit (Tom Green) persuades his down-to-earth friend (Jason Lee) to commit robbery to pay for college tuition.","large":"John (Jason Lee) is a hard-working guy who only wants to marry his longtime girlfriend Elaine (Leslie Mann). Elaine and John have vowed to marry once they save $30,000 for their dream house. Things are fine until John's sister calls to remind him of his promise to pay his niece's tuition, which costs $29,829 and is due in two weeks! John turns to his friend Duff (Tom Green) to help him make $30,000 quickly. Duff convinces John to make a short-term commitment to petty crime.

programme.title: Whatever It Takes
programme.desc: Two teenagers use contrived e-mails, phone calls and double dates to win their dream girls (Marla Sokoloff, Jodi Lyn O'Keefe).","large":"A nerdy teen, Ryan Woodman (Shane West) is smitten with the popular and gorgeous Ashley Grant (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe), who apparently has no interest in him. Meanwhile, dim star athlete Chris Campbell (James Franco) has his eye on Ryan's brainy and beautiful friend, Maggie Carter (Marla Sokoloff). The two agree to help each other in their romantic quests, but, as they come closer to their goals, both Ryan and Chris suspect that they might be pursuing the wrong girls.

programme.title: The Waterdance
programme.desc: Paralyzed by a hiking accident, a young writer (Eric Stoltz) struggles to adjust among other men in a hospital ward.","large":"Injured in a climbing accident, writer Joel Garcia (Eric Stoltz) wakes up in a hospital having lost the use of his legs. Soon after, he's placed in a recovery ward where he begins the arduous process of rehabilitation and meets others with injuries like his own. Raymond (Wesley Snipes) is a ladies' man whose girl has nevertheless split, and Bloss (William Forsythe) is a rather prejudiced biker. Together, this unlikely trio helps one another to overcome the greatest challenge of their lives.

programme.title: Finding Graceland
programme.desc: A man (Johnathon Schaech) meets a Marilyn Monroe impersonator (Bridget Fonda) while traveling with an aging hitchhiker (Harvey Keitel) who thinks he is Elvis.","large":"En route to Memphis, Tenn., on a solemn solo road trip, widower Byron Gruman picks up a disarming hitchhiker who claims to be the late, great Elvis Presley. As Gruman opens up about the loss of his wife, Beatrice, in a tragic car accident, his bizarre passenger becomes a surprisingly powerful source of wisdom and comfort. The duo even picks up a Marilyn Monroe impersonator, Ashley, during the surreal pilgrimage to Graceland.

programme.title: Nothing in Common
programme.desc: A yuppie adman (Tom Hanks) faces his parents' (Jackie Gleason, Eva Marie Saint) separation and his father's need for a major operation.","large":"A successful advertising executive, David Basner, is working on a project that could make him partner at his company. When his parents suddenly end their 36-year marriage, he is thrown into the role of caregiver, dealing with his delicate mother, Lorraine, and his combative father, Max, who provides constant aggravation and bitter remarks. When one of his parents gets sick, David must choose what is more important, his family or his career.

programme.title: Running With Scissors
programme.desc: A man looks back on his unusual childhood, his mentally ill mother (Annette Bening) and her unorthodox therapist (Brian Cox).","large":"As the son of an alcoholic father and a mentally ill mother, young Augusten Burroughs faces a challenging childhood at the very least. His life takes an unexpected turn when his mother gives him to her unorthodox therapist, and the boy becomes a member of the doctor's own strange, extended family.

programme.title: Relative Chaos
programme.desc: Encouraged by his girlfriend (Charisma Carpenter), a man (Christopher Gorham) joins his two siblings for their father's (Terry Bradshaw) weeklong event of competitive games.

programme.title: The Green Hornet
programme.desc: The heir (Seth Rogen) to a newspaper fortune joins forces with a resourceful company employee (Jay Chou) to bring a powerful Los Angeles crime lord to justice.","large":"Britt Reid (Seth Rogen), the heir to the largest newspaper fortune in Los Angeles, is a spoiled playboy who has been, thus far, happy to lead an aimless life. After his father (Tom Wilkinson) dies, Britt meets Kato (Jay Chou), a resourceful company employee. Realizing that they have the talent and resources to make something of their lives, Britt and Kato join forces as costumed crime-fighters to bring down the city's most-powerful criminal, Chudnofsky (Christoph Waltz).

programme.title: Close Encounters of the Third Kind: The Director's Cut
programme.desc: Close encounter of the first kind: sighting of a UFO. Close encounter of the second kind: physical evidence. Close encounter of the third kind: contact.","large":"Science fiction adventure about a group of people who attempt to contact alien intelligence. Roy Neary (Richard Dreyfuss) witnesses an unidentified flying object, and even has a "sunburn" from its bright lights to prove it. Roy refuses to accept an explanation for what he saw and is prepared to give up his life to pursue the truth about UFOs.

programme.title: Battle: Los Angeles
programme.desc: After the world's great cities fall, a Marine staff sergeant (Aaron Eckhart) and his platoon make a last stand against alien invaders.","large":"For many years, humans have reported various UFO sightings around the world, fueling speculation about the existence of life on other worlds. In 2011, mankind learns the truth the hard way when alien invaders attack. One by one, the world's great cities fall, leaving Los Angeles as the battleground for humanity's last stand. It's up to a Marine staff sergeant (Aaron Eckhart) and his platoon to draw a line in the sand against a powerful enemy unlike any previously encountered.

programme.title: Hardwired
programme.desc: A man (Cuba Gooding Jr.) turns to hackers for help after he awakes from a car accident and learns he has a computer chip implanted in his brain.","large":"After surviving a car crash that kills his pregnant wife, Luke Gibson (Cuba Gooding Jr.) wakes up in the hospital with complete amnesia. He's been severely injured, but is alive thanks to a groundbreaking brain implant from a powerful multinational corporation. As Luke recovers, he starts to realize his implant is dangerous and seeks help from Hal (Michael Ironside), the leader of a group of hackers. A shadowy executive (Val Kilmer) tries to stop Luke and Hal before they learn too much.

programme.title: Air
programme.desc: When breathable air becomes nonexistent, two engineers (Norman Reedus, Djimon Hounsou) must guard the remaining survivors who reside in a controlled state of suspended animation.

programme.title: Bermuda Triangle
programme.desc: A physician's (Sam Behrens) family is stranded on an island community of survivors presumed lost in the infamous Bermuda Triangle.

programme.title: Facing the Giants
programme.desc: A Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick) inspires the players on his losing team through his steadfast belief in God.","large":"Grant Taylor, a Christian high-school football coach (Alex Kendrick), gets some very bad news. Besides his and his wife's (Shannen Fields) infertility problems, he faces the attempt of local parents to force the school to replace him. His team, the Shiloh Eagles, has never had a winning season in the six years that he has coached the boys. Following a visitor's message, Grant tries to inspire his team to use faith to conquer fear and opposing teams.

programme.title: Wild America
programme.desc: Three Arkansas brothers (Jonathan Taylor Thomas, Devon Sawa, Scott Bairstow) travel across the country filming animals in their habitats during the summer of 1967.","large":"The fearless young Stouffer brothers -- Marty (Scott Bairstow), Mark (Devon Sawa) and Marshall (Jonathan Taylor Thomas) -- can hardly imagine going into the family business hawking auto parts in small-town Arkansas. With the begrudging approval of their no-nonsense father, the brothers set out on a dangerous cross-country camping trip, intending to capture on film their encounters with wild animals and the last remnants of the natural world in the rapidly vanishing American West.

programme.title: Jack and Jill
programme.desc: The life of a successful, happy ad executive descends into chaos when his needy, passive-aggressive twin sister (also Sandler) makes her annual Thanksgiving visit.","large":"Thanksgiving is usually a happy time, but ad executive Jack (Adam Sandler) dreads the holiday because his twin sister, Jill (also Sandler), makes her annual visit. When Jack and his sister get off on the wrong foot, the only way to make it right is to invite her to stay through Hanukkah. But, when actor Al Pacino (Al Pacino), whom Jack desperately needs to star in a commercial, takes a shine to Jill, Jack may be forced to extend his sister's visit even longer.

programme.title: Last Action Hero
programme.desc: A golden ticket, a memento handed down from Houdini, puts a boy in the middle of a Hollywood superstar's lavish and secretive world.","large":"Following the death of his father, young Danny Madigan (Austin O'Brien) takes comfort in watching action movies featuring the indestructible Los Angeles cop Jack Slater (Arnold Schwarzenegger). After being given a magic ticket by theater manager Nick (Robert Prosky), Danny is sucked into the screen and bonds with Slater. When evil fictional villain Benedict (Charles Dance) gets his hands on the ticket and enters the real world, Danny and Jack must follow and stop him.

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: Stranded in the wilderness, a mule deer (Ashton Kutcher) and a domesticated bear (Martin Lawrence) try to make their way back to the safety of a town preserve before a hunter catches them.","large":"Boog (Martin Lawrence), a 900-pound grizzly bear, is content entertaining tourists and living in park ranger Beth's (Debra Messing) barn. His life takes a drastic turn when he rescues a one-horned mule deer named Elliot (Ashton Kutcher) from a hunter (Gary Sinise), and is subsequently tranquilized and returned to the wild. Elliot and Boog recruit the other animals, notably a Scottish squirrel (Billy Connolly) and a beaver foreman, to help turn the tables on the hunters to make the woods safe.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Daddy Warbucks (Albert Finney) protects little orphan Annie (Aileen Quinn) from Miss Hannigan (Carol Burnett) and crooks in Depression-era New York.","large":"An orphan in a facility run by the mean Miss Hannigan, Annie believes that her parents left her there by mistake. When a rich man named Oliver "Daddy" Warbucks decides to let an orphan live at his home to promote his image, Annie is selected. While Annie gets accustomed to living in Warbucks' mansion, she still longs to meet her parents. So Warbucks announces a search for them and a reward, which brings out many frauds.

programme.title: The Undercover Man
programme.desc: Determined Treasury Department investigator Frank Warren (Glenn Ford) goes after a ruthless mobster known as The Big Fellow. When a key informant is murdered, Warren pursues the gangster on charges of tax evasion. But, with a slick mob lawyer hampering him at every turn, and threats being lobbed toward Warren's wife (Nina Foch), the lawman's chances of achieving a conviction are slim to none. His only hope is that one syndicate bookkeeper will have the courage to turn state's evidence.

programme.title: Murderers' Row
programme.desc: On a quest for world domination, Julian Wall (Karl Malden) and his evil cohorts in the Brotherhood of International Government and Order kidnap Dr. Solaris (Richard Eastham). Solaris invented a heliobeam, a weapon capable of cataclysmic destruction. It's up to secret agent Matt Helm (Dean Martin) to rescue Solaris before he is brainwashed into using the heliobeam. Helm poses as a gangster, seducing Solaris' daughter, Suzie (Ann-Margret), along the way.

programme.title: Scandal Sheet
programme.desc: Editor Mark Chapman (Broderick Crawford) presides over a trashy but financially successful tabloid newspaper in New York City. With his hotshot crime reporter, Steve McCleary (John Derek), and feature writer, Julie Allison (Donna Reed), Chapman attends a Lonely Hearts Club publicity stunt sponsored by the paper, where he's shocked to run into Charlotte (Rosemary DeCamp), the wife he abandoned two decades before. Their argument takes a violent turn that might ruin everything Chapman has.

programme.title: Hook, Line and Sinker
programme.desc: With a terminal diagnosis that has left him with just months to live, insurance salesman Peter (Jerry Lewis) decides to take an extravagant, around-the-world fishing tour. Mid-trip, Peter is informed by his doctor, Scott (Peter Lawford), that a malfunctioning electrocardiograph had caused a misdiagnosis and he will live. Now, faced with crippling debt from his travels, Peter resolves to fake his own death to secure a life insurance claim for his wife, Nancy (Anne Francis).

programme.title: Only Angels Have Wings
programme.desc: Rough and tough Geoff Carter (Cary Grant) runs a tiny airline that cannot afford to miss any flights, despite the dangers along many of the routes. When Bonnie Lee (Jean Arthur), a performer who is falling for him, sees that Geoff is preparing to fly in violent weather conditions, she takes measures to make him stay. She's successful in her attempt, and two of his employees are forced to make the flight for him -- but Bonnie may have been correct about the potential peril of that flight.

programme.title: Boots Malone
programme.desc: Has-been agent Boots Malone (William Holden) is dodging his creditors and living on the edge of the horse racing world when wealthy teenager Tommy Gibson (Johnny Stewart) asks Malone to take him under his wing as a jockey-in-training. While trying to stay one step ahead of Matson (Hugh Sanders), a well-connected gambler he owes money to, Malone and his partner, Stash (Stanley Clements), introduce the idealistic Tommy to the seedy underbelly of horse racing, where cons and tricks rule.

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: Spurred by love for the beautiful Lady Linet (Patricia Medina), humble sword-maker John (Alan Ladd) begins training to become a knight. When a raid on the castle leads to the death of Linet's mother and the incapacitation of her father, the earl of Yeonil (Harry Andrews), John's chase after the evildoers is misunderstood as cowardly running away. Transforming himself into the mysterious Black Knight, John infiltrates the castle of King Arthur (Anthony Bushell) to unmask the ne'er-do-wells.

programme.title: The Daring Young Man
programme.desc: After the military turns him down as being unfit, a man proves himself a hero by cracking a Nazi spy ring.

programme.title: All Ashore
programme.desc: Sailors Joe (Dick Haymes) and Skip (Ray McDonald) habitually take advantage of their shipmate, Moby (Mickey Rooney), who's robbed after they take him to a shady bar. When they have no money to go to Catalina Island, Calif., Joe arranges their travel by volunteering the clueless Moby to work on the ship. Skip later meets a glamorous dancer (Peggy Ryan), while Joe woos a nightclub owner (Jody Lawrance). Moby decides to leave, but finds himself coming to the rescue of a beautiful heiress.

programme.title: The Taming of the Shrew
programme.desc: In this film adaptation of the classic Shakespeare play, Grumio and Hortensio both long to wed the same beautiful young woman. Unfortunately, her wealthy father will not let his daughter marry unless her hot-tempered sister, Katharina, also has a suitor. Luckily, the slovenly Petruchio is looking for an affluent woman to marry, so Grumio and Hortensio pay him to try to woo the extremely volatile Katharina.

programme.title: Don't Knock the Twist

programme.title: Diamond Head
programme.desc: The head (Charlton Heston) of a Hawaiian pineapple dynasty refuses to let his sister (Yvette Mimieux) marry a native.

programme.title: Boston Blackie and the Law
programme.desc: Reformed thief Blackie (Chester Morris) does a magic show in a women's prison, during which an inmate escapes.

programme.title: Let's Do It Again
programme.desc: In this musical comedy, composer Gary Stuart (Ray Milland) and his wife, Connie (Jane Wyman), have an argument over her alleged affair with Courtney Craig (Tom Helmore). The Stuarts agree to get divorced, and each tries to move on to a new love: Gary with socialite Deborah Randolph (Karin Booth) and Connie with businessman Frank McGraw (Aldo Ray). However, they start to realize that they still have strong feelings for each other. The Stuarts must make a decision before their divorce is final.

programme.title: The Doctor Takes a Wife
programme.desc: A writer (Loretta Young) and a neurologist (Ray Milland) accept rumors of their marriage when each stands to gain from the mistake.

programme.title: Paula
programme.desc: After her second miscarriage, Paula Rogers (Loretta Young) learns she is sterile. On the way to a reception for her professor husband, John (Kent Smith), a distraught Paula accidentally hits an orphan (Tommy Rettig) with her car. Thinking Paula is drunk, farmer Raymond Bascom (Will Wright) takes the boy to the hospital. Unwilling to confess her role in the hit-and-run for fear of derailing John's career, Paula volunteers at the hospital and helps Davey recover without admitting her guilt.

programme.title: Gidget
programme.desc: Diminutive teenager Francie Lawrence (Sandra Dee) has a bunch of boy-crazy friends, but she couldn't care less about boys. That is, until she goes to the beach one day and meets surfer Jeffrey Moondoggie Matthews (James Darren) and his friends, including Burt The Big Kahuna Vail (Cliff Robertson). Now, Francie, whom the boys call Gidget -- short for girl midget -- wants to learn how to surf, so she buys a used board and dives into the sunny world of Southern California surfing fever.

programme.title: The Mating of Millie
programme.desc: A businesswoman (Evelyn Keyes) asks a bachelor (Glenn Ford) to help her find a husband so she can adopt an orphan.

programme.title: Funny Girl
programme.desc: In this bittersweet, classic musical drama, the vibrant and beautiful young Fanny Brice (Barbra Streisand) starts out as a bit player on the New York City vaudeville stage, but works her way up to stardom on Broadway. Valued for her vocal and comedic talents by the renowned theater impresario Florenz Ziegfeld (Walter Pidgeon), Fanny thrives, but her relationship with her suave, imprisoned businessman husband, Nick Arnstein (Omar Sharif), is another story.

programme.title: Oliver!
programme.desc: In this award-winning adaptation of the Broadway musical based on the Charles Dickens novel, 9-year-old orphan Oliver Twist (Mark Lester) falls in with a group of street-urchin pickpockets led by the Artful Dodger (Jack Wild) and masterminded by the criminal Fagin (Ron Moody). When Oliver's intended mark, Mr. Brownlow (Joseph O'Conor), takes pity on the lad and offers him a home, Fagin's henchman Bill Sikes (Oliver Reed) plots to kidnap the boy to keep him from talking.

programme.title: Gidget Grows Up
programme.desc: Gidget goes to New York, becomes a U.N. guide and meets an older man.

programme.title: The Happy Time
programme.desc: A large French-Canadian family suddenly expands when father Jacques (Charles Boyer) invites an out-of-work magician's assistant to be their live-in maid. At the same time, charming ladies' man Uncle Desmond (Louis Jourdan) comes back to town to replace a sales manager who has died, and subsequently begins a romance with the new maid. Jacques' son Bobby watches these interactions with confused curiosity as he makes the tough transition from boyhood to adolescence.

programme.title: The Howards of Virginia
programme.desc: When his impoverished past is uncovered, Matt Howard is promptly fired by the Peytons, a wealthy family in Williamsburg during the Revolutionary War era. Undeterred, Matt returns to court the family's daughter, Jane, and the two marry and raise a family in the Virginia backwoods, infuriating the Peytons. The birth of a crippled son results in years of tension between Matt and Jane, and, when Matt decides to join the army, Jane makes a stunning decision.

programme.title: You Can't Run Away From It
programme.desc: Furious over the elopement of his daughter, Ellie (June Allyson), with a fortune hunter, millionaire A.A. Andrews (Charles Bickford) has her kidnapped and sequestered on his yacht. Ellie defies her father by escaping and taking a bus to meet her husband, only to lose all her money to a thief. After Ellie accidentally allows the bus to leave without her, she is befriended by fellow passenger Peter Warne (Jack Lemmon), an unemployed reporter who knows her identity and is primed for a scoop.

programme.title: Holiday
programme.desc: Johnny (Cary Grant) seems like a solid match for Julia (Doris Nolan), the socialite daughter of Edward Seton (Henry Kolker). Assured that Johnny is a worthy suitor, Edward approves of the pairing. But, as Johnny's wanderlust surfaces -- he is more interested in traveling than in business -- Edward starts to have doubts. Johnny also begins to wonder if he might not be a better match for Linda (Katharine Hepburn), Julia's outspoken younger sister, with whom he has much more in common.

programme.title: It Happened to Jane
programme.desc: After a shipment of fresh lobsters isn't delivered on time to Jane Osgood (Doris Day), a widowed mother of two running a failing restaurant supply business in Maine, she hires her lawyer friend George Denham (Jack Lemmon) to sue the railroad company she believes is responsible for the damages. The court case generates lots of publicity and Osgood is famous. A charismatic news reporter (Steve Forrest) takes to Osgood, but that doesn't sit well with Denham, who also has eyes for her.

programme.title: The Long Gray Line
programme.desc: High-spirited Irish immigrant Marty Maher (Tyrone Power) is an awkward misfit at West Point until he's taken in as an assistant by kindly athletic director Capt. Herman J. Koehler (Ward Bond). A budding romance that turns into a happy marriage to a fellow Irish immigrant, housemaid Mary O'Donnell (Maureen O'Hara), also helps Maher mellow into a beloved and long-standing fixture at the military academy, where his career as an officer and mentor spans 50 years. This film is based on a true story.

programme.title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner
programme.desc: When Joanna Drayton (Katharine Houghton), a free-thinking white woman, and black doctor John Prentice (Sidney Poitier) become engaged, they travel to San Francisco to meet her parents. programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: In 2008, Wall Street guru Michael Burry realizes that a number of subprime home loans are in danger of defaulting. Burry bets against the housing market by throwing more than $1 billion of his investors' money into credit default swaps. His actions attract the attention of banker Jared Vennett (Ryan Gosling), hedge-fund specialist Mark Baum (Steve Carell) and other greedy opportunists. Together, these men make a fortune by taking full advantage of the impending economic collapse in America.

programme.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
programme.desc: Easily excitable Neal Page (Steve Martin) is somewhat of a control freak. Trying to get home to Chicago to spend Thanksgiving with his wife (Laila Robins) and kids, his flight is rerouted to a distant city in Kansas because of a freak snowstorm, and his sanity begins to fray. Worse yet, he is forced to bunk up with talkative Del Griffith (John Candy), whom he finds extremely annoying. Together they must overcome the insanity of holiday travel to reach their intended destination.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Mutated graboids return to feast on the residents of Perfection, threatening its new status as a tourist attraction.","large":"Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: An alien that can duplicate other life forms invades a polar research station in this remake of the 1951 classic "The Thing from Another World."","large":"In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: An acid-scarred scientist (Liam Neeson) uses 99-minute masks to be with his girlfriend (Frances McDormand) and trap gangsters.","large":"When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: George Lucas' tale of an extraterrestrial duck who is mistakenly brought to Cleveland by an experimental laser beam.","large":"In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: A suburban homeowner's vacation with his wife becomes a horror after some odd neighbors move in next door.","large":"Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: An irresponsible playboy becomes emotionally attached to a woman's12-year-old son. The man and child help each other in an unlikely friendship.","large":"A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: A nursing-home resident (Jessica Tandy) regales a visitor (Kathy Bates) with tales of the close friendship between two women in the 1930s Alabama.","large":"On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: A middle-class man (Steve Martin), his wife (Mary Steenburgen), his father and a divorcee (Dianne Wiest) try to be good parents.","large":"Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: An architect (Steve Martin) has a girlfriend (Dana Delany) who won't move into his house and a dizzy woman (Goldie Hawn) who won't move out.","large":"Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: A police detective (James Belushi) with a girlfriend (Mel Harris) gets stuck with a new partner, a German shepherd dog.","large":"Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression, a doctor, once a psychiatric patient, uses humor and unconventional methods in his practice.","large":"After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: An aspiring filmmaker (Winona Ryder) follows the paths of her friends after they graduate from college in Texas.","large":"After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After spending time in a remote village to atone for his past, a martial artist (Jet Li) gets caught in a duel to defend China's honor against his country's enemies.","large":"After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: A scam artist (Terrence Howard) introduces a young man (Channing Tatum) to New York's bare-knuckle street-fighting circuit.","large":"Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld.","large":"A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: A deranged suitor (Mark Wahlberg) torments family and friends of a teen girl (Reese Witherspoon) with whom he is obsessed.","large":"When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. David is exciting and charming, and despite the wide age gap, he wins over Nicole's family -- except for her workaholic father, Steven (William Petersen), who's suspicious of David from the start. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: A woman (Kate Hudson) takes a job as a hospice nurse for a couple (Gena Rowlands, John Hurt) who live in a New Orleans house with a troublesome history.","large":"Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: A woman and her 9-year-old twin sons encounter the evil spirit of Bughuul in a rural house that's marked for death.","large":"Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: Drag Me to Hell
programme.desc: Christine Brown has a good job, a great boyfriend, and a bright future. But in three days, she's going to hell.","large":"Christine Brown has a loving boyfriend and a good job at a Los Angeles bank. Her heavenly life becomes hellish when, in an effort to impress her boss, she denies an old woman's request for an extension on her home loan. In retaliation, the crone places a curse on Christine, threatening her soul with eternal damnation. Christine seeks a psychic's help to break the curse, but the price to save her soul may be more than she can pay.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: After their daughter is assaulted and left for dead, a couple (Tony Goldwyn, Monica Potter) take revenge on the assailants, who have taken shelter at the couple's house.","large":"Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge, is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach.","large":"A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: The Guardian

The young parents are forced to fight supernatural forces for the life of their vulnerable offspring.

programme.title: I Saw What You Did

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: Rule benders and sneaky geniuses: these are stories of creative risk-takers who know that sometimes you have to break the rules to be the hero.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: There are a million ways to modify a car, but few like these stories. From a manufacturer creating a narrow-use case spec, to one guy making a complete unicorn in his garage, we celebrate some forgotten oddballs of the mod world.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: Certain men in the history of cars were just made from different stuff; these two drivers achieved insane feats against impossible odds to prove that they are legends among legends.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: Taking a trip back in time to the early days of the automobile, when the first enterprising car enthusiasts laid the foundations for the car world today.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: Some cars carry powerful myths with them long after they are gone; these are stories of cars whose intriguing legends have endured long past the metal they are made from.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: The quest for speed has been ingrained in humans since the birth of the wheel; these are stories of people who gathered like-minded speed freaks and created outlaw cultures of pushing the limits of public roads.

programme.sub-title: Beat Down 350Z Drift Missile to Street Shark Dripping With Style
programme.desc: "Hot Rod Garage" built a Nissan 350Z drifter with a welded differential, hydraulic handbrake, steering angle kit and not much else; then they abandoned it; Nads and Amir try to salvage this one with some much-needed style and a Formula Drift debut.

But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed.

programme.title: RoboCop
programme.desc: In a violent, near-apocalyptic Detroit, evil corporation Omni Consumer Products wins a contract from the city government to privatize the police force. To test their crime-eradicating cyborgs, the company leads street cop Alex Murphy (Peter Weller) into an armed confrontation with crime lord Boddicker (Kurtwood Smith) so they can use his body to support their untested RoboCop prototype. But when RoboCop learns of the company's nefarious plans, he turns on his masters.

programme.title: RoboCop 2
programme.desc: Cyborg Detroit policeman Alex Murphy is the sole officer on duty after the police force goes on strike against evil conglomerate Omni Consumer Products and its push to foreclose on the city of Detroit. Aside from dealing with the normal level of crime, Murphy must take on crime boss Cain, the spread of a dangerous new drug called Nuke and the attempt by psychologist Dr. Juliette Faxx to create another RoboCop using a hardened criminal.

programme.title: RoboCop 3
programme.desc: Greedy corporation Omni Consumer Products is determined to begin development on its dream project, Delta City, which will replace the derelict Detroit. To achieve this end, O.C.P. is employing armed forces to bully residents out of the city, under the guise that they are just doing their part to reduce crime and root out thugs. After RoboCop (Robert John Burke) joins the civilian resistance, he sustains severe injuries but recovers to battle advanced ninja robots developed by O.C.P.

programme.title: Indipendente Mente
programme.desc: La moda del gas esilarante. Boom tra giovanissimi della droga della risata. In esclusiva la storia di una mamma che lotta contro la dipendenza del figlio. Sono questi gli effetti di una nuova droga in voga tra i giovanissimi e di cui però c'è ancora scarsa consapevolezza. È la droga del palloncino.

programme.title: Powering the Future
programme.desc: Dr. M. Sanjayan, lead scientist at The Nature Conservancy, shines a spotlight on America's quest for clean energy. The four-part series addresses the challenge from every angle and cuts through all the rhetoric by establishing a target: identifying a clean, limitless, secure energy supply and a way for it to be delivered. Sanjayan discusses new technologies that could end the dependence on fossil fuels; explains how the natural world can create energy; filters out politics and special interests to reveal statistics on energy waste; and tells of unlikely characters and companies that are leading the way in an energy sea change.

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: Diagnose unbekannt - Leben mit einer seltenen Erkrankung
programme.desc: Rund 8.000 seltene Krankheiten existieren weltweit. Doch sie werden nur wenig erforscht. Die möglichen Profite für Pharmaunternehmen sind zu gering. Für die Patienten bedeutet das: mit ihrer Krankheit leben lernen.

programme.title: Besser essen, länger leben?
programme.desc: Eine gesunde Ernährungsweise ist wichtig für die Gesundheit. Ärzte, Köche und Ernährungswissenschaftler zeigen, wie man sich gesünder ernähren kann, indem man frische Zutaten in Mahlzeiten einbaut. Dabei kommt auch der Geschmack nicht zu kurz.

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: ADHS bei Erwachsenen - Hummeln im Hirn
programme.desc: ADHS galt lange als Krankheit von Kindern und Jugendlichen. Doch sie kann auch Erwachsene betreffen, wenn sie nicht früh erkannt wird und unbehandelt bleibt. Knapp fünf Prozent der Erwachsenen haben ADHS - und wissen es oft nicht.

programme.title: Tierische Superhelden
programme.desc: Tiere passen sich extremen Bedingungen an: Frösche nutzen Frostschutzmittel in der Leber, Eisbären verlangsamen den Stoffwechsel, Pompeji-Würmer schützen sich mit einem Chitinpanzer und Japanmakaken wärmen sich in heißen Quellen.

programme.title: Tierische Superhelden
programme.desc: Die Kämpfer des Tierreichs wissen sich zu verteidigen. Alligatorenschildkröten nutzen ihren Panzer mit hornartigen Schuppen und scharfen Stacheln als Schutzschild. Die Stacheln des Stachelschweins verfügen über kleine Widerhaken.

programme.title: Wildes Brasilien
programme.desc: Die weiten Grasebenen im Herzen Brasiliens, die zu den am wenigsten bekannten Regionen des Landes zählen, werden porträtiert. Diese Graswelt voller Termitenbauten ist zehnmal so groß wie die Serengeti Afrikas, doch Tierherden sucht man vergeblich. Mähnenwölfe, Ameisenbären, Prärieeulen und Kapuzineraffen führen hier ein eher verstecktes Leben, geprägt von Hitze, Gewitterstürmen und Steppenfeuern.

programme.title: Wildes Brasilien
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation führt in die Wasserwelt des Pantanal. Jaguare, Fischotter und Wasserschweine sind im Labyrinth aus Flüssen, Seen und Inseln im Vorteil, bis die jährlichen Regenfälle einsetzen. Dann wandelt sich das Pantanal in eine ausgedehnte Sumpflandschaft, in der Kaimane, Fische und Anacondas in ihrem Element sind. Auch Vögel, wie der Jabiru und der Hyazinth-Ara, haben im Pantanal eine sichere Heimat gefunden.

programme.title: Leuchtfeuer des Lebens
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation widmet sich Lebewesen, die ihr eigenes Licht produzieren können. Das ist nicht nur nützlich, sondern auch lebenswichtig für die Wesen, die in der Dunkelheit überleben müssen. Anzutreffen sind sie beispielsweise nachts, in dunklen Höhlen oder der Tiefsee. Dazu gehören Würmer, Pilze und Bakterien. Mithilfe ihres Leuchtens können sie sowohl Beute anlocken als auch Feinde abschrecken oder einen Partner zur Fortpflanzung finden.

programme.title: Die Sicht der Spinne
programme.desc: Derek Muller enthüllt die Geheimnisse des faszinierenden Sehvermögens von Spinnen.

programme.title: Welt der Insekten
programme.desc: Auf der Erde gibt es zwischen fünf und zehn Millionen verschiedene Arten und bis zu zehn Quintillionen Insekten. Das macht die Erde zweifelsfrei zu einem Insektenplaneten. Viele dieser winzigen Tierchen haben außergewöhnliche Fähigkeiten.

programme.title: Welt der Insekten
programme.desc: Die Sendung befasst sich mit der Paarung und Fortpflanzung von den Insekten der Erde. Sie sind kleine Lebewesen in einer großen Welt und haben Tricks entwickelt, um sich gegenseitig für die Paarungsrituale zu finden und Nachwuchs zu zeugen.

programme.title: Welt der Insekten
programme.desc: Soziale Insekten wie Ameisen, Bienen, Wespen und Termiten breiten sich sehr erfolgreich aus. Laut Schätzungen wiegen die Ameisen der Welt so viel wie alle Menschen zusammen. Und das Gewicht der Termiten entspricht dem aller Landwirbeltiere.

programme.title: Bright Now!
programme.desc: Ein alarmierender Rückgang der Insektenpopulationen könnte alles Leben auf der Erde vernichten. In dieser Episode wird untersucht, was dieses Phänomen verursachen könnte und ob es etwas gibt, was getan werden kann, um es zu stoppen.

programme.title: Titans of Defense
programme.desc: In befreundeten und feindlichen Gewässern verfügen die am feinsten abgestimmten Kriegsschiffe und U-Boote der Militärgeschichte über Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen Tarnfähigkeit, Geschwindigkeit, Tragfähigkeit und Angriffsstärke.

programme.title: Titans of Defense
programme.desc: Ob sie wichtige Versorgungsgüter zum Schlachtfeld fliegen, über Kampfeinsätzen schweben oder internationale Missionen unter schwierigsten Bedingungen durchführen: Militärhubschrauber sind für ihre Aufgaben bestens gerüstet.

programme.title: Die Prärie - Rückkehr der Wildnis

programme.title: Wenn die Welt innehält - Natur im Aufschwung
programme.desc: Als die Welt während der Pandemie stillstand, erholten sich Ökosysteme und Tierarten kehrten zurück.

programme.title: Welt ohne Wasser
programme.desc: Die Wasserknappheit ist in vielen Regionen der Erde wie etwa in Kalifornien zu einem großen Problem geworden. Experten suchen dringend nach Lösungen, die Entdeckung eines riesigen Grundwasserleiters vor der amerikanischen Küste weckt Hoffnungen.

programme.title: Asien in der Klimakrise
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation zeigt die Regionen, die infolge des Klimawandels von Überflutung bedroht sein werden. Betroffen sind bis zum Jahr 2100 über eine Milliarde Menschen in niedrig gelegenen Küstengebieten, davon 70 Prozent alleine in Südostasien.

programme.title: Asiens Ozeane im Wandel
programme.desc: Die Wissenschaftler des Earth Observatory in Singapur wollen herausfinden, was Küstenstädte zum Sinken bringt. Außerdem sollen Gelder aufgebracht werden, um die Region zukünftig für die Auswirkungen des Klimawandels zu rüsten.

programme.title: Asiens Ozeane im Wandel
programme.desc: Die Wissenschaftler des Earth Observatory in Singapur forschen nach den Folgen des Klimawandels für Küsteninfrastrukturen inklusive Häfen und den Handel. Außerdem wollen sie wissen, wie gut die betroffenen Gebiete vorbereitet sind.

programme.title: Asiens Ozeane im Wandel
programme.desc: Die Wissenschaftler des Earth Observatory of Singapore tauchen ab und erforschen die Auswirkungen des Klimawandels auf den Ozean und sammeln Ideen für künstliche Riffe. Sie entdecken eine Korallenart, die resistent gegen den Klimawandel ist.

programme.title: Asiens Ozeane im Wandel

programme.title: TGV: Der große Check-up
programme.desc: Das Technikzentrum Hellemmes in der Nähe von Lille ist das größte Wartungszentrum der SNCF für den Personenverkehr in Frankreich. Der Standort ist auf Wartung und Modernisierung spezialisiert. Die Sendung wirft einen Blick hinter die Kulissen.

programme.title: Held des Ackers - Ein Hightech-Traktor entsteht
programme.desc: Der Axion 960 CEMOS gilt in Fachkreisen als ein Traktor mit besonders nachhaltiger Technologie. Die Maschine benötigt bis zu 20 Prozent weniger Kraftstoff bei einer Leistung von maximal 445 PS. Die Modelle werden in Frankreich gebaut.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Windkraftanlagen erzeugen weltweit inzwischen mehr als 700 Gigawatt Strom, genug, um fast 500 Millionen Haushalte zu versorgen. Eine Schlüsselrolle kommt künftig leistungsstarken Offshore-Windparks wie East Anglia One vor der britischen Küste zu.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Die Suche nach einer neuen, vor allem nachhaltigen Energiequelle ist die bislang größte technische Herausforderung. Forscher arbeiten seit Jahren an der Entwicklung eines Fusionsreaktors, der endlos Energie liefern soll, bislang vergebens.

programme.title: Die Tricks der Pflanzen
programme.desc: Es gibt viel mehr fleischfressende Pflanzen, auch Karnivoren genannt, als bisher angenommen. Selbst die bekannten Arten wie Sonnentau und Venusfliegenfalle weisen noch unbekannte Verhaltensweisen auf. Die Dokumentation beschreibt, wie fleischfressende Pflanzen ihre Beute anlocken, fangen und verdauen, um sich mit lebensnotwendigen Stoffen zu versorgen.

programme.title: Requiem in Weiss - Das würdelose Sterben unserer Gletscher
programme.desc: Ein Filmteam dokumentiert den Rückzug der Gletscher in Österreich, Deutschland, Italien und der Schweiz. An vierzehn Gletschern zeigt der Film, wie das Eis schwindet und sich die Landschaft verändert. Wissenschaftler und weitere Fachleute erläutern die Entwicklungen und ihre Folgen. Gleichzeitig richtet sich der Blick auf den wachsenden Tourismus und Eingriffe wie Gletscherabdeckungen, Kunstschneeanlagen und Geländeplanierungen. So entsteht ein eindringliches Porträt einer Landschaft im Wandel.

programme.title: Der Extrembergsteiger
programme.desc: Jost Kobusch hat sich zum Ziel gesetzt, den jeweils höchsten Berg auf den sieben Kontinenten zu besteigen. Den 26-Jährigen zieht es dorthin, wo noch niemand vor ihm war - und wenn doch, dann wählt er andere Routen, um zum Gipfel zu gelangen. Immer ist er allein unterwegs, ohne Hilfsmittel oder Sherpas und vorzugsweise im Winter, wenn niemand außer ihm den Trip wagt.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Auto Motor Party
programme.desc: Das Werner Rennen in der norddeutschen Tiefebene ist nicht nur etwas für Fans der Comic-Kult-Figur: Das Musik- und Motorsportfestival zieht zehntausende Besucher aus ganz Deutschland an. Auf fünf Rennstrecken beweisen sich mehr als tausend Fahrer.

programme.title: Benzin meets Kerosin
programme.desc: Blitzendes Chrom, bollernde V8-Motoren und kreischende Zweitakter - einmal im Jahr treffen sich Motorverrückte auf dem "Wings & Wheels"-Festival in Uetersen. Mehr als eintausend Oldtimer, Custom-Bikes und PS-starke Classic Cars tummeln sich dann auf einem kleinen Flugplatz vor den Toren Hamburgs. Ein Highlight des benzingetränkten Wochenendes sind spektakuläre Flugstunts am Himmel.

programme.title: Wilde Wege
programme.desc: Im Nordosten Georgiens, an der Grenze zu Russland, führt die Abano-Straße in luftige Höhen. Mit fast 3.000 Metern ist der Abano-Pass die höchste befahrbare Straße im Großen Kaukasus. Sie schlängelt sich an schwindelerregenden Steilhängen empor.

programme.title: Wilde Wege
programme.desc: Der Trans-Sulawesi Highway ist die Lebensader der viertgrößten Insel Indonesiens und verbindet verschiedene Orte. Traumhafte Strände, turbulente Großstädte oder tiefe Urwälder. Als Busfahrer auf dem Highway braucht man Know-how und starke Nerven.

programme.title: Wilde Wege
programme.desc: Im äußersten Nordosten Norwegens, der Finnmark, sind die Winter eiskalt und schneereich. Durch die Lage am Arktischen Ozean sind die Straßen anfällig für Schneeverwehungen. Jeder Meter ist eine Herausforderung und eine Fahrt ins Risiko.

programme.title: Adrenalinjunkies
programme.desc: Gleich hinter der tschechischen Grenze trifft Action auf Adrenalin und taktisches Denken auf Teamgeist. Beim Gotchaspielen kann man Dampf ablassen, dem Alltag entfliehen und sich dabei gleichzeitig fit halten. Tim Bauer kennt alle 12 Spielfelder.

programme.title: Adrenalinjunkies
programme.desc: Im Off-Road Park gelten andere Regeln als im Straßenverkehr. Die Sendung ist geeignet für Menschen, die schon als Kind vom Bagger fahren träumten. Auf einem riesigen Spielplatz werden Tatra-LKWs, Quads und Offroad-Trainer bewegt.

programme.desc: Im Herzen Nordamerikas liegen die Northern Great Plains. Die Grasweisen scheinen oft endlos, doch die Wildnis ist stark bedroht. Wo einst Herden von Bisons und Gabelböcken grasten, erstreckt sich über weite Gebiete Agrar- oder Farmland.

programme.title: Wenn die Welt innehält - Natur im Aufschwung
programme.desc: Als die Welt während der Pandemie stillstand, erholten sich Ökosysteme und Tierarten kehrten zurück.

programme.title: Asien in der Klimakrise
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation zeigt die Regionen, die infolge des Klimawandels von Überflutung bedroht sein werden. Betroffen sind bis zum Jahr 2100 über eine Milliarde Menschen in niedrig gelegenen Küstengebieten, davon 70 Prozent alleine in Südostasien.

programme.title: Welt ohne Wasser
programme.desc: Die Wasserknappheit ist in vielen Regionen der Erde wie etwa in Kalifornien zu einem großen Problem geworden. Experten suchen dringend nach Lösungen, die Entdeckung eines riesigen Grundwasserleiters vor der amerikanischen Küste weckt Hoffnungen.

programme.title: Requiem in Weiss - Das würdelose Sterben unserer Gletscher
programme.desc: Ein Filmteam dokumentiert den Rückzug der Gletscher in Österreich, Deutschland, Italien und der Schweiz. An vierzehn Gletschern zeigt der Film, wie das Eis schwindet und sich die Landschaft verändert. Wissenschaftler und weitere Fachleute erläutern die Entwicklungen und ihre Folgen. Gleichzeitig richtet sich der Blick auf den wachsenden Tourismus und Eingriffe wie Gletscherabdeckungen, Kunstschneeanlagen und Geländeplanierungen. So entsteht ein eindringliches Porträt einer Landschaft im Wandel.

programme.title: Der Extrembergsteiger
programme.desc: Jost Kobusch hat sich zum Ziel gesetzt, den jeweils höchsten Berg auf den sieben Kontinenten zu besteigen. Den 26-Jährigen zieht es dorthin, wo noch niemand vor ihm war - und wenn doch, dann wählt er andere Routen, um zum Gipfel zu gelangen. Immer ist er allein unterwegs, ohne Hilfsmittel oder Sherpas und vorzugsweise im Winter, wenn niemand außer ihm den Trip wagt.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Auto Motor Party
programme.desc: Das Werner Rennen in der norddeutschen Tiefebene ist nicht nur etwas für Fans der Comic-Kult-Figur: Das Musik- und Motorsportfestival zieht zehntausende Besucher aus ganz Deutschland an. Auf fünf Rennstrecken beweisen sich mehr als tausend Fahrer.

programme.title: Benzin meets Kerosin
programme.desc: Blitzendes Chrom, bollernde V8-Motoren und kreischende Zweitakter - einmal im Jahr treffen sich Motorverrückte auf dem "Wings & Wheels"-Festival in Uetersen. Mehr als eintausend Oldtimer, Custom-Bikes und PS-starke Classic Cars tummeln sich dann auf einem kleinen Flugplatz vor den Toren Hamburgs. Ein Highlight des benzingetränkten Wochenendes sind spektakuläre Flugstunts am Himmel.

programme.title: Wilde Wege
programme.desc: Im Nordosten Georgiens, an der Grenze zu Russland, führt die Abano-Straße in luftige Höhen. Mit fast 3.000 Metern ist der Abano-Pass die höchste befahrbare Straße im Großen Kaukasus. Sie schlängelt sich an schwindelerregenden Steilhängen empor.

programme.title: Wilde Wege
programme.desc: Der Trans-Sulawesi Highway ist die Lebensader der viertgrößten Insel Indonesiens und verbindet verschiedene Orte. Traumhafte Strände, turbulente Großstädte oder tiefe Urwälder. Als Busfahrer auf dem Highway braucht man Know-how und starke Nerven.

programme.title: Wilde Wege
programme.desc: Im äußersten Nordosten Norwegens, der Finnmark, sind die Winter eiskalt und schneereich. Durch die Lage am Arktischen Ozean sind die Straßen anfällig für Schneeverwehungen. Jeder Meter ist eine Herausforderung und eine Fahrt ins Risiko.

programme.title: Adrenalinjunkies
programme.desc: Gleich hinter der tschechischen Grenze trifft Action auf Adrenalin und taktisches Denken auf Teamgeist. Beim Gotchaspielen kann man Dampf ablassen, dem Alltag entfliehen und sich dabei gleichzeitig fit halten. Tim Bauer kennt alle 12 Spielfelder.

programme.title: Adrenalinjunkies
programme.desc: Im Off-Road Park gelten andere Regeln als im Straßenverkehr. Die Sendung ist geeignet für Menschen, die schon als Kind vom Bagger fahren träumten. Auf einem riesigen Spielplatz werden Tatra-LKWs, Quads und Offroad-Trainer bewegt.

programme.title: Adrenalinjunkies
programme.desc: Die Vorstellung, vom Gleitschirm aus die atemberaubende Aussicht auf die Erde zu genießen, fasziniert viele. Fluglehrer Lukas Bader bringt seinen Schülern genau das bei, indem er sie in der notwendigen Theorie für einen Flugschein unterrichtet.

programme.title: Faszination Rollenspiel
programme.desc: Den Neusser Krieg von 1475 inszenieren hunderte europäische Spätmittelalter-Rollenspieler wieder. In der Stadt Zons am Rhein stehen kostümierte Männer mit Schwertern und Lanzen, um diese historische Schlacht wieder auf zu erleben.

programme.title: Faszination Rollenspiel
programme.desc: Die Frightguys sind Fans von Grauen und Grusel - oder kurz dem Horror-Genre. Sie leben mit ihren selbst gemachten Kostümen auf Conventions und Szene-Treffen ihre schönsten Albträume aus, um in die Rollen ihrer schauderhaften Figuren zu schlüpfen.

programme.title: Holzhochhäuser - Die Jagd nach dem Rekord
programme.desc: Globale Skylines im Wandel: Holzhochhäuser, die wie Pflanzen aus der Erde sprießen, erobern die Architekturwelt. Pioniere nutzen innovative Techniken, um aus dem nachwachsenden Rohstoff Holz lebendige Wohnkomplexe zu schaffen.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Heute ist die Bauindustrie für einen großen Anteil des weltweiten Energieverbrauchs verantwortlich. Es gibt keine Anzeichen darauf, dass sich dies in naher Zukunft ändern wird. Umso wichtiger werden umweltfreundliche Materialien wie Holz.

programme.title: Gorgona - Europas letzte Gefängnisinsel
programme.desc: Mitten in Europa liegt die Gefängnisinsel Gorgona. Vor Italiens Küste sitzen hier rund hundert Schwerverbrecher ihre Strafen ab. Ihren Alltag verbringen die Straftäter nachts hinter Gefängnismauern und tagsüber mit harter Arbeit auf der Plantage.

programme.title: Russlands Gewalt-Problem
programme.desc: Im russischen Alltagsleben ist Gewalt genauso allgegenwärtig wie im Machtapparat. Auch unter den Bürgern gilt meist das Recht des Stärkeren. Immer mehr Menschen wollen das allerdings nicht mehr hinnehmen. Sie wünschen sich ein anderes Russland.

programme.title: Re:
programme.desc: Schweden hat seit Jahren ein Problem mit der Bandenkriminalität. Jeden Monat sterben dort mehr Menschen durch Schusswaffen als in anderen europäischen Ländern. Schießereien und Bombenanschläge erschüttern das Land. Die Täter werden immer jünger.

programme.title: Re:
programme.desc: Auf den Gewässern von Europa kommt es oft zu schweren Bootsunfällen durch Fahrlässigkeit. Denn einige Freizeitkapitäne ignorieren die Regeln des Schiffsverkehrs und die Tempolimits sowie Promillegrenzen und verursachen Unfälle.

programme.title: Im Netz der Betrüger
programme.desc: Tricksen, Täuschen, Manipulieren - die Methoden der Betrüger werden immer raffinierter. Zurück bleiben Opfer, die oft nicht nur einen hohen finanziellen Verlust erlitten haben, sondern von dem Betrug auch psychisch gezeichnet sind.

programme.title: Dreiste Plagiate
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation behandelt die Produktpiraterie. Mit gefälschten Luxusgütern wie Kleidung, Parfum und Uhren bekannter Marken setzen die Fälscher jedes Jahr Milliarden von Euro um. Viele der Plagiate enthalten schädliche Giftstoffe für den Menschen.

programme.title: Der lange Schatten des IS
programme.desc: Im Jahr 2017 besiegte der Irak offiziell die aufständischen Kämpfer vom "Islamischen Staat" im Nordosten des Landes rund um das Erdölzentrum Kirkuk. Die Terrororganisation agiert seither im Untergrund, verfolgt von einer Spezialeinheit der Regierung.

programme.title: Geheimnisvolles Asien: Kambodscha
programme.desc: Die Menschen Kambodschas bemühen sich leidenschaftlich um den Erhalt der beeindruckenden Kultur ihres Landes. So klettern Honigjäger im Urwald des Kulen-Gebirges auf die höchsten Bäume, um an das süße Gold der Wildbienen zu kommen.

programme.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber

programme.desc: Documentarian Rex (David Krumholtz) follows ruthless reality television producer Katy Courbet (Eva Mendes), a woman who will stop at nothing to revive the American Broadcasting Network's failing ratings -- and forward her own career. To the dismay of the government, Courbet approves a reality show that will become network television's first foray into snuff. In the first episode, contestants engage in a deadly game of Russian roulette for the chance at a multi-million-dollar cash prize.

rating.system: Dirección General de Radio, Televisión y Cinematografía

programme.title: Flaming Bullets
programme.desc: A criminal syndicate has been illegally freeing convicts, only to murder them after authorities offer reward money for the fugitives' scalps. Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) are charged with catching the thugs, and they hit upon a plan: Dave will get himself put in jail, the thugs break him free and Tex and Panhandle will arrest them. But, when the criminals realize the Rangers are closing in, things turn deadly.

programme.title: Rimfire
programme.desc: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost.

programme.title: Stars Over Texas
programme.desc: Cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) have come to the end of a tough cattle drive, but, instead of the rancher they were expecting, they're welcomed by his sister, young Terry Lawrence (Shirley Patterson). It seems that Terry's brother and one of his employees were wounded by gun-toting thugs. Eddie and Soapy realize that they'll need to get to the bottom of things, so they devise a clever plan to lure the bad guys back to the scene.

programme.title: Return of the Lash
programme.desc: Cheyenne Davis (Lash La Rue) comes to the rescue of a group of ranchers who are losing their homes to a gang of malicious outlaws. When Davis and his sidekick, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), capture the outlaws, they collect reward money to distribute to the ranchers. But Fuzzy, who is in charge of delivering it, loses the money as well as his memory. Now it's up to Davis to set things right and prevent land baron Jim Kirby (George Chesebro) from getting his hands on the cash.

programme.title: Stage to Mesa City
programme.desc: Valiant U.S. Marshal Cheyenne Davis (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his trusty deputy, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are on their way to aid a stagecoach owner who is mired in financial burdens. But, when they arrive and discover he's been murdered, the loyal pair are asked by Margie (Jennifer Holt), his daughter, to seek out his killers and make them pay for their vile crime. The investigation soon leads them to a sneering lawyer (Marshall Reed), who has a mysterious boss.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: Undercover federal marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is suspected by the local sheriff, Jake (George Hayes), of stealing the town's payroll, but his suspicions are sidelined when young Betty Mason (Eleanor Hunt) announces that her father, an important businessman, has been murdered. Without him, supplies will not reach town, and homesteaders will starve. When town leader Malgrove (Edward Peil) offers to buy the locals out, John and Jake get suspicious, and uncover a land-grabbing conspiracy.

programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: Adopted by the wealthy rancher Arch Strobie, orphan Owen Daybright (Burt Lancaster) grows to be a respectable foreman on Strobie's ranch. Strobie's natural son, Lee (Robert Walker), is jealous of Owen and finally finds a way to undermine his upstanding brother. When Lee conceives an illegitimate child with Lily Fasken (Sally Forrest), who refuses to name him as the father, he tells her revenge-minded brothers that Owen is to blame, hoping they'll take his half-brother out of the picture.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: Borderland
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy fools even his partner by acting like a badman to catch a gang of badmen.

programme.title: Massacre
programme.desc: A tribe of hostile Native Americans goes on the warpath, slaughtering white men with guns sold to them by mercenary outlaws.

programme.title: The Proud Rebel
programme.desc: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. Desperate to cure the boy, Chandler takes David to a small town in Illinois where he hopes to find a doctor. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault -- and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland).
